title: Maximal subalgebras of the Lie algebra $W_n(\mathbb{K})$
summary: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, $A= K[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the polynomial ring in $n$ variables, and let $W_n(K)$ be the Lie algebra of all $K$-derivations of $A.$ This Lie algebra also is the free $A$-module of rank $n$ over the ring $A,$ so every subalgebra of $W_n(K)$ has a rank $\leq n$ over $A.$ We prove that every maximal subalgebra of rank $\leq n$ of $W_n(K)$ is a simple Lie algebra.
